opportunities.title: Compositional Retrieval & Episodic Translation Engine
opportunities.problem_description: Users remember intersecting cues (e.g. 'friend + beach + 2 years ago') but search engines treat terms as disjoint keywords or fail when more than one constraint is added.
opportunities.solution_direction: Multi-cue semantic graph joining visual concepts, relative timeframes, and social clusters into a single unified query resolver.

opportunities.title: Conversational Intent Grounding & Anti-Hallucination for Ask Photos
opportunities.problem_description: When users use natural language with Ask Photos, the LLM often retrieves visually random screenshots or unrelated pets because it lacks strict library grounding constraints.
opportunities.solution_direction: Strict two-stage retrieval: LLM decomposes query into verifiable library metadata filters first, followed by visual-embedding similarity reranking.

opportunities.title: Relative-Time & Fuzzy Temporal Query Resolution
opportunities.problem_description: Human episodic memory remembers seasons, life milestones, or relative spans ('last summer', 'around college graduation'), but search demands calendar dates.
opportunities.solution_direction: Calendar-agnostic temporal mapping that translates relative phrases into dynamic probabilistic date windows.

opportunities.title: Progressive Refinement & Anti-Scroll Fallback
opportunities.problem_description: When a query produces 0 results or noisy results, users have no interactive affordance to narrow the search; each edit wipes context, forcing endless timeline scrolling.
opportunities.solution_direction: Context-preserving query chips and interactive facet sliders (e.g. 'Only during summer', 'Exclude screenshots', 'Photos with people').

opportunities.title: Evaluative Context & Result Disambiguation
opportunities.problem_description: Search displays dense grids of visually similar thumbnails without showing dates, locations, or why a photo matched, making target verification exhausting.
opportunities.solution_direction: Memory-anchored result cards displaying match rationales, landmark tags, and timeline markers on hover/tap.

opportunities.title: Utility Document & OCR Isolation in Personal Memory Search
opportunities.problem_description: Searches for personal visual memories return prescription bottles, receipt screenshots, and memes that contain coincidental text or color matches.
opportunities.solution_direction: Strict intent classification separating Utility/Document retrieval from Personal Episodic Recall.

ranking_comparison.title: Compositional Retrieval Gap (Multi-Cue Failure)
ranking_comparison.pm_rationale: In the raw corpus, users don't say 'compositional query'. They say 'I searched beach Goa restaurant and got nothing'. When filtered for actual retrieval breakdowns, this is the #1 root cause of failed searches.

ranking_comparison.title: Gemini / Ask Photos Intent & Hallucination Friction
ranking_comparison.pm_rationale: Ask Photos was introduced recently; raw volume is lower than 10 years of backup complaints. However, for future retrieval strategy, conversational AI failure is the top emerging strategic risk.

ranking_comparison.title: Relative-Time & Temporal Vagueness
ranking_comparison.pm_rationale: Human memory is episodic and relative. When users cannot recall exact calendar months, search hits a wall, creating direct drop-off.

ranking_comparison.title: Refinement Recovery & Endless Scroll Fatigue
ranking_comparison.pm_rationale: Scrolling fatigue is a symptom of failed recovery, not an isolated preference. It occurs when initial search fails and offers no progressive narrowing.

ranking_comparison.title: Screenshot & Meme Clutter Polluting Search
ranking_comparison.pm_rationale: In the old pipeline, clutter ranked #1 because thousands of users complain about storage limits and memes filling their feed. In retrieval with partial memory, clutter is an aggravating factor, not the primary query breakdown.
